text:
Alex C: Pager hit for model-serving-us-east-1 - sustained errors on the n1 pool, 502s from router->runtime. Notified by IncidentBot.
IncidentBot: ALERT: model-serving-us-east-1 - 502 error rate > 8% for 3m. Pager routed to @Alex C and @Oncall-Lead. Link: https://rwinf/alerts/1798502468
Maria G: seeing increased 95th p95 latency in traces too, likely kv-cache thrash during compaction window.
Samir: logs show repeated "KVCache: miss and fallback" and a spike of model reloads at 23:12 UTC. Attaching snippet: `stack: model-runtime -> router -> kvcache`
Emily P: any customer-facing impact? Product Ops says a handful of API clients reported timeouts, support queue has 6 related tickets. tagging @Product Ops
Oncall-Lead: quick mitigation - scale n1 pool by +20% and add temporary routing rule to send non-critical /embeddings to n2-west. I can cut the policy now.
Alex C: applying routing change now. `rbctl route set --region us-east-1 --model-default n2-west --filter 'type!=critical'`
Samir: scaling done, adding a 30s drain delay to avoid thrash. Monitoring.
Maria G: after scale, error rate dropped to 1.2% and p95 latency down by ~430ms. Good.
Emily P: support update: adding note to tickets that we saw transient infra issue and a mitigation is in place.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT: 1798502468 -> status: mitigated (evidence: error rate back under threshold). Duration: 22m.
Alex C: ok handing off to post-incident review. We need a 30-45m postmortem sync tomorrow. Who can own the writeup + actions?
Maria G: I can own the timeline + root cause analysis (RCa).
Samir: I'll own remediation: reduce compaction overlap with heavy inference windows and add a KVCache health probe to avoid silent reloads.
Oncall-Lead: I'll schedule the postmortem and add to the oncall rota for follow-up. Proposed time: tomorrow 16:00 UTC.
Emily P: Product needs a short customer-impact blurb for the support team and a decision on whether to notify customers. My recommendation: notify impacted customers with a 1-sentence summary and link to postmortem.
Alex C: agree. Maria, please include a customer impact section in the writeup. Samir - add a concrete remediation ticket with acceptance criteria.
Maria G: noted. adding the following to the writeup template: `customer_impact: [IDs], duration, percent_failed, mitigation`
Samir: creating remediation Jira: RW-INC-3492. Remediation steps: 1) stagger compaction windows; 2) add KVCache probe + alert; 3) review autoscale thresholds. Acceptance: no repeat errors in 7 days under similar load.
Oncall-Lead: creating postmortem doc in docs/incidents/1798502468-postmortem.md and will post calendar invite for 16:00 UTC.
Alex C: action owners and owners' timeline: Maria (RCa + doc) due EOD tomorrow, Samir (remediation plan + tickets) due in 3 days, Oncall-Lead (runbook edits) due in 5 days.
Emily P: assign communications: I'll draft the customer note and get legal review if needed.
Samir: small runbook change to add immediate mitigation step: if kvcache reload rate > 5/min, scale pool + drain 30s and route non-critical. Proposed snippet to add to runbook (please review):
```
# Runbook excerpt: KVCache thrash mitigation
- Detect: `kvcache.reload.rate > 5/min` OR `router.502.rate > 5%`
- Mitigate: `rbctl pool scale --name n1 --delta +20% --drain-delay 30s`
- Fallback: `rbctl route set --region <region> --model-default <alt_pool> --filter 'type!=critical'`
- Post: create ticket, notify product and support
```
Oncall-Lead: looks good. Also add a note to escalation path: after 2 failed mitigations escalate to infra-eng pager.
Alex C: we should also add a short checklist for handoffs: 1) current status + key metrics 2) actions taken 3) outstanding work 4) estimated ETA 5) owner contact. I'll paste that into the oncall playbook.
Maria G: one more thing - we observed a correlation with a rollout job scheduled at 23:10 UTC. I've flagged the deploy owner (cc @sam-deploy) to check for coincident config changes.
Samir: I've added KVCache probe to the monitoring dashboard and an alert rule: `kvcache_reload_rate > 3/min -> pager to @sre` (lower threshold for early warning).
IncidentBot: POST-INC ACTIONS CREATED: RW-INC-3492 (remediation), RW-INC-3493 (postmortem doc), RW-INC-3494 (runbook edits)
Emily P: small note — please include whether any customers had PII touched or any compliance concerns.
Maria G: no PII involved, this was infra-only. I'll add that to the impact section.
Oncall-Lead: tagging reactions: :white_check_mark: for owners, :eyes: for reviewers. I'll run a quick follow-up sync 48h after remediation roll.
Alex C: thanks all. Handoff complete. If anything regresses ping here and I'll re-open the incident channel.
Product Ops: noted and standing by for the customer note.
IncidentBot: Incident 1798502468 archived to incidents/1798502468-postmortem.md
Emily P: will draft customer note now and share in the doc for sign-off.
Samir: closing loop on deployment correlation - deploy owner confirmed a non-breaking config tweak, but it did increase compaction concurrency. Adding a post-deploy check to avoid overlap.
Maria G: draft postmortem link: https://rwinf/docs/incidents/1798502468-postmortem.md - inviting reviewers.
Alex C: great job team.
